known_constraints: Do not modify main directly or merge pull requests automatically.
Do not claim tests or simulations passed unless a run result proves it.
Synthetic fixtures are not physical measurements or field-performance evidence.
Do not treat the 175.8 uH current-sheet estimate as a measured final inductance.
Evaluate an independent Greenhouse-style segment inductance method before choosing final coil inductance.
Include the 12 radial transition connectors and correct current directions in any segment-based coil inductance model.
Do not expose secrets in source files, reports, or logs.
Free-only: no paid API, subscription, hosted service, or paid runner.
The local task queue edits the JSON memory file only; it does not push commits or call remote services.

current_evidence.greenhouse_review: Added a theoretical audit of the straight round-wire partial self-inductance formula, its uniform-DC internal-field assumption, the exact Grover/Rosa expression and long-wire approximation, and the need to distinguish partial inductance from a complete two-terminal measurement including return leads. Strengthened segmentation-invariance acceptance test: preserve length alone is insufficient; splitting requires the corresponding mutual term in a finite-cross-section-consistent reference. Documentation only; no numerical engine or tests executed. Further review against the NBS Rosa–Grover primary source (1912) identified a distinct collinear-adjacent-segment case, equation (102): h=0 must not be passed to the offset-parallel filament formula. The study now specifies merge of contiguous same-direction collinear conductor pieces as one physical straight segment, or use the dedicated collinear mutual term if retained separately; overlapping collinear geometry requires explicit review. Acceptance test G-04 now requires the collinear mutual term when testing subdivision invariance. Documentation only; no calculation engine/tests executed. Clarified an important GMD distinction from NBS Rosa–Grover equation (136): for two non-overlapping circular cross-sectional areas, their mutual GMD equals the center spacing exactly. This does not make center-spacing substitution exact in the finite-length Neumann kernel; it is exact only in the logarithmic/GMD reduction, while the finite-segment reference remains the cross-sectional average. Documentation only; no numerical engine/tests executed. Added energy-based derivation of L_eq = sum(L_ii) + 2 sum_{i<j}(M_ij) for one series path carrying identical current, with explicit no-double-count rules for self/internal and mutual terms, one-time direction sign, and full-matrix versus unordered-pair summation. Added physical-corner limitation: sharp 90-degree polyline has zero ideal-filament mutual term for perpendicular straight pieces, but a real rounded bend requires measured bend radius and arc refinement; added acceptance tests G-13/G-14. Documentation only; no numerical engine/tests executed. Added Section 5 on copper skin depth and proximity effect for the 0.60 mm wire: reference δ values at 1 kHz, 10 kHz, 50 kHz, 100 kHz and 1 MHz; radius crossover near 48.5 kHz as a gradual scale, not a sharp threshold; pulse spectrum must be derived from measured current waveform and edge times rather than repetition frequency alone; adjacent-turn proximity requires actual segment direction; separated quasi-static L, frequency-dependent Z(f), and transient PI response. Documentation only; no pulse spectrum, proximity factor, impedance, simulation, or physical measurement established; no coil defaults changed. Added a small Python reference module simulation/spiral/conductor_effects.py with validated helpers for classical copper skin depth, the frequency where delta equals wire radius, and the approximate first-order 10-90% edge-knee scale; added five unit tests and registered the module/tests in tools/islam_agent/audit.py. The five new tests passed in an isolated local Python test run of the helper logic. This is not a full repository audit or GitHub Actions pass; latest GitHub Actions remains startup_failure before jobs. The helper intentionally does not calculate proximity effect, pulse spectrum, or PI transient response.
